note: Re-judged 2026-11-25 by an independent agent after commit 1f82b2727d reworded comments in xfrmStateFromParams (netlink to netlink library). RFC 4301 Section 4.2: "Note: A compliant implementation MUST NOT allow instantiation of an ESP SA that employs both NULL encryption and no integrity algorithm." No logic or assertion changed: planStateAlgos and xfrmAuthName still require an integrity transform on every non-AEAD ESP SA, refusing absent or "none" integrity before returning a state. TestRFC4301ESPNullEncryptionWithIntegrityIsInstantiated still asserts the null cipher with HMAC-SHA-256, TestRFC4301ESPNullEncryptionWithoutIntegrityIsRefused requires an error and nil state for absent and "none" integrity, TestRFC4301VPPESPNullEncryptionWithoutIntegrityIsRefused requires ErrNotSupported and no SAD message beside a valid control, and TestIPsecESPRequiresIntegrity refuses absent integrity and accepts SHA-256. Verdict stands.
